parsed.explanation: The dossier documents a state moving to criminalise trans identity itself: the 2026 bill (passed, assent widely expected) sets up to 3 years for identifying as transgender, longer for advocacy, plus a duty to report — a tier-1/tier-2 exposure where the institutions are the threat, with judicial review deferred until signature. Alongside it: an existing 'unnatural carnal knowledge' offence, documented mob justice against perceived LGBT people, raids and forced closure of community infrastructure by security services, no anti-discrimination protection, and a society whose recorded attitudes are hostile (religious pressure driving the bill; a poll showing most oppose recognition). No remedy operates; the court has refused to intervene pre-assent. Prison placement for trans detainees is undocumented (an open question, not an added exposure), and no enforcement record yet exists for the 2026 bill — but the imminent identification offence plus documented state-tolerated violence place this in the severe band.
